Insero Brand Style Guide

Visual identity
system.

The foundational elements of the Insero brand — logo, color, typography, and core components. Reference this when building customer-facing materials, internal tools, or partner collateral.

Version 1.0 · April 2026
Identity

Logo

The Insero mark pairs the glass-ring icon with the "insero" wordmark. Use the full lockup when space allows; the compact mark (no tagline) is for tight contexts like favicons, app icons, and inline references.

Primary lockup · light backgrounds
Primary lockup · dark backgrounds
Compact · no tagline · light backgrounds
Compact · no tagline · dark backgrounds

Usage guidelines

Clear space
Maintain clear space around the logo equal to at least half the height of the icon ring. No other visual element should enter this zone.
Minimum size
Never reproduce the full lockup smaller than 120px wide on digital, or 1 inch on print. Use the compact mark below those sizes.
Backgrounds
Use the light variant on white or pale backgrounds. Switch to the dark variant on deep brand colors, photography, or any background darker than Gray 300.
Never do
Do not rotate, skew, outline, add drop-shadows, or recolor the icon. Do not reproduce the glass icon in a single flat color — the transparent glass effect is part of the brand.

Foundations · 05

Typography

Two typefaces carry the system. Plus Jakarta Sans for headlines, interface elements, and anything where the brand's voice needs to project. Open Sans for body copy and long-form content — warm, humanist, and highly legible.

DISPLAY / UI · Plus Jakarta Sans · weights 500–800
Plus Jakarta Sans
Used for headlines, navigation, buttons, and labels. Geometric, modern, confident.
Hero · 36pt
Insero

Explore services
BODY / CONTENT · Open Sans · weights 400–700
Open Sans
Used for body paragraphs, long-form content, and readable text. Humanist, warm, highly legible.

Insero is your trusted technology advisor. We research options, get pricing, identify the best solutions, and support you through implementation — all at zero cost to you. Our role is simple: eliminate the busy work, distill the market into a clear recommendation, and stay with you from signing through rollout.

Smaller body copy uses the same font at a reduced size. Line height stays generous to preserve readability across screen and print.

Buttons

Primary buttons use forest green. Reserve accent (tangerine) for the single highest-priority action in any view. Secondary and ghost buttons for less emphatic actions.
